title: [stpmgrd] File descriptor leak: fopen without fclose in debug reload check
author: rustiqly

linkedPullRequests.title: [agent][stpmgrd] Fix file descriptor leak in debug reload check
linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did
Fix FILE* leak in stpmgrd debug reload check.

#### How I did it
Store `fopen()` result in a local variable and `fclose()` after use.

#### How to verify it
Run stpmgrd under valgrind — no more leaked file descriptors from the debug reload check.

#### Which release branch to backport
master

#### Description for the changelog
Fix file descriptor leak in stpmgrd debug reload file check.

Fixes: #4391
